#!/bin/sh
CONFIGFILE=/etc/ssh/sshd_config
TEMPFILE=$(mktemp)
trap "rm -f $TEMPFILE" EXIT
while IFS= read -r line; do
    # Remove leading/trailing whitespace
    trimmed=$(echo "$line" | sed -e 's/^[[:space:]]*//' -e 's/[[:space:]]*$//')
    # Skip empty lines and comments
    if [ -z "$trimmed" ] || [ "${trimmed#\#}" = "#" ]; then
        echo "$line" >> "$TEMPFILE"
        continue
    fi
    # Parse key=value (first whitespace)
    key=$(echo "$trimmed" | cut -d'=' -f1)
    value=$(echo "$trimmed" | cut -d'=' -f2-)
    # Normalize key for case-insensitive compare
    key_lower=$(echo "$key" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')
    if [ "$key_lower" = "gssapiauthentication" ]; then
        # Found key, set value to no
        echo "GSSAPIAuthentication no" >> "$TEMPFILE"
        found=true
    else
        # Output original line
        echo "$line" >> "$TEMPFILE"
    fi
done < "$CONFIGFILE"
# If key not found, append default
if [ "$found" != "true" ]; then
    echo "GSSAPIAuthentication no" >> "$TEMPFILE"
fi
# Replace original with temp
mv "$TEMPFILE" "$CONFIGFILE"
